message:
Structural Dynamicist and Retrofit and Maintenance Engineer, the device stays invisible from deck eye height.

The retrofit lives fully below the walking surface with no change to parapet, floor or sightlines. The Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), a sprung mass moving out of phase with the deck, needs moving mass 800 kg per the Den Hartog sizing (E11) and total hung load 9.81 kN per the hung load estimate (E29), about thirteen body weights and about a washing-machine cube, carried between girders above the screen per the midspan layout sketch (E12).

Retrofit and Maintenance Engineer and the Manager, the device hides behind a girder-colour perforated screen with fixed and moving parts separated. Fixed parts are cross-beam, clamps and screen, moving parts are springs plus damper plus mass free only vertically, with zero millimetres projection above the walking surface and below-deck cassette shown in the under-deck recessed cassette sketch (E30), holding depth open until stroke is frozen by Structural Dynamicist. Not ready, because damped acceleration and stroke are still needed to fix screen depth.
